description: Ministry of Water Supply - Udubaddawa OIC Office of Bingiriya Udubaddawa Water Supply, Welimada phase Water Supply (Webillegama), Gurutalawa Nawithikumbura Phase 2 Water Supply Projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific land parcels for water supply projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land properties, including plot numbers, extents, boundaries, and claimant information. While a government minister is named (Vasudeva Nanayakkara), this is incidental to the main purpose of the document, which is land acquisition for specific projects. The focus is on the land properties being acquired rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
